test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hearty
solution:
The correct answer is **Aloof.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym refers to words **which are opposite** to each other.
 
• “**Hearty”** means **very close or near and dear.**
 
• Therefore, **Aloof **is the **suitable antonym** as aloof **means distant or unfriendly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Cordial"** poses the same meaning as **hearty.**
 
• **"Warm"** originally means hot, but it is also used in the **sense of passionate or friendly**.
 
• "**Robust" **means "**immense" or "strong".**
